title: DecisionFlow: Advancing Large Language Model as Principled Decision Maker

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment on the Medical Triage Alignment (MTA) dataset using multiple-choice questions to measure the model's adherence to 12 specific target biases across 6 dimensions of human trust and ethical reasoning (Protocol Focus, Fairness, Risk Aversion, Continuing Care, Moral Desert, and Utilitarianism).
